The '''SoroSuub Centroplex''' was the headquarters of the [[SoroSuub Corporation]] on the [[planet]] of [[Sullust]].<ref name="Battlefront" /> The Centroplex's tech division developed weapons, sensors, vehicles, and other technological goods for the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Planets Battlefront">{{EA|subdomain=starwars|url=starwars/battlefront/planets|text=''Star Wars'' Battlefront Planets|nolive=1}}</ref> Shortly following the [[Siege of Inyusu Tor]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sent [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinders]] to eliminate the Imperial forces stationed at the SoroSuub Centroplex.<ref name="Battlefront" />
